extension.summary: Install and update the Cumnation add-on
extension.description: Repository for the Cumnation video add-on. Add this to receive Cumnation and its updates directly inside Kodi.
extension.news: v1.0.1 - Update URLs (info/checksum/datadir) now point at GitHub Pages instead of raw.githubusercontent.com. Raw GitHub still works for individual files (nothing breaks for anyone on 1.0.0), but Pages doesn't encode the branch name into the URL, so a future default-branch rename won't strand already-installed clients' updates the way changing `main` in a raw URL would.
